candidates.summary: Best (A; overlaps the other two, which are its halves): check_for_player_collision_with_mover_Y gets its own copy of calculate_mover_x_max_and_y_max (its only full-entry caller), saving JSR/RTS (12 cycles a call); in both copies the right edge is computed first, so the no-carry exit (BCS not taken, 2 cycles instead of BCC taken, 3) leaves C=0 for the height's ADC and its CLC goes, the skeleton test is AND/EOR (neither touches C), and the rare x carry is out of line.
candidates.equivalence: Same outputs (mover_x_max_high/low = (&C5:0)+width+x_low 16-bit, mover_y_max = height + mover_y with height &11 for frame &0D, X unchanged, Y = type) on every path. Width add: CLC; ADC mover_x_low; BCS not taken leaves C=0, STA/LDA/AND/EOR/BEQ/LDA do not touch C, so ADC mover_y adds with C=0 as the CLC did; the carry path does INC (C unchanged, =1), CLC, BRA back. The skeleton test AND #&7F; EOR #&0D gives Z iff frame&&7F = &0D as CMP did; the skeleton path LDA #&11 keeps C=0. In the inlined copy the exit is STA mover_y_max; LDX #0; BEQ check_for_collision_with_mover (Z from LDX, always taken) exactly as JSR calc; LDX #0; BEQ did; check_for_collision_with_mover's first instruction is a JSR that overwrites A and Y and nothing before it reads A, Y or the flags the old calc left; no caller of calc reads its exit A, flags or C/V (the +4 caller's next lines are LDX first_mover then LDA last_mover; CLC).
candidates.relies_on: No data moves. calculate_mover_x_max_and_y_max's first four bytes (LDA &C5 : STA mover_x_max_high) stay first, so the only other caller, 'JSR calculate_mover_x_max_and_y_max + 4' (game.6502:3515), still lands on LDA movers_type_and_colour,X. mover_x_max_high/low and mover_y_max (&C6/&C7/&C9) are stored in a different order but nothing reads them between. The window grows 44 bytes (all code from check_for_collision_with_mover on slides up 44 bytes, absorbed by unused_3400_original's SKIP; everything from &3400 stays). Branch page crossings downstream change both ways (listing diff: about 30 branches); MEASURED in a scratch tree on the bench build (unshifted DEBUG_LIVES), pcprof work a pass (render+irq+logic, wait excluded) on seed 1 / holding RIGHT: 34457 -> 34395 (-62) and 39690 -> 39625 (-65), the instruction count alone being about 35. passlock 3000 passes seed 1: state identical. check_for_collision_with_mover moves &254B -> &2577; cfc_a_leave_clear and its BEQ move together, still one page.
